I specialize in pronunciation and accent training, using my background in linguistics—particularly phonetics and phonology—to create personalized lessons tailored to each student's native language.

Whether you're looking to refine your pronunciation, gain confidence in speaking, or develop a more natural accent, I will help you achieve your goals with a research-based, customized approach!

course_info.trial_description: Let's get to know each other! In this trial lesson, you'll have the chance to speak and share a bit about yourself, your background, and your language-learning goals. pro_course_detail.title: Mastering Pronunciation: Tailored Accent Training for Clearer Speech
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you struggle with pronunciation or feel like your accent makes it harder to be understood? In this lesson, we’ll work on refining your pronunciation by focusing on the specific challenges that come from your native language. I analyze phonetic and phonological patterns in your language to design personalized exercises that target the most important sounds for you.

With my background in linguistics, I specialize in phonetics (how sounds are formed) and phonology (how sounds interact in speech). We'll use IPA, listening exercises, and targeted drills to help you gain confidence and sound more natural in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn Latin - Grammar Fundamentals & Reading Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
Latin comes to life when you build a solid foundation! My lessons focus on:

✅ Grammar fundamentals—so you can confidently understand and form Latin sentences
✅ Reading fluency—so you can engage with a variety of texts more naturally

For beginners, we’ll cover essential grammar and vocabulary. If you have some experience, we’ll focus on reading comprehension and building fluency through guided exercises and texts. My structured yet immersive approach will help you read Latin with confidence!

pro_course_detail.title: Learn Ancient Greek - Grammar Fundamentals & Reading Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
Ancient Greek can be challenging, but I’ll help you build a strong foundation! My lessons focus on:

✅ Grammar fundamentals—so you can understand and form Greek sentences
✅ Reading fluency—so you can engage with a variety of Greek texts

For complete beginners, we’ll start with essential grammar and vocabulary. If you have prior experience, we’ll refine your skills through guided reading exercises and comprehension strategies. Whether you want to read Classical or Koine Greek, I’ll tailor the lessons to your goals.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson type is for those wishing to improve their ability to naturally speak the English language. This can also include improving your ability to read in English, as well. Conversations will ultimately be based around the goals of the student - there is no single defined structure for every lesson because every student is different. Some students want to have a purely random conversation where the topic can potentially change over time. Other students prefer to focus on a specific topic or have a specific goal in mind (a future interview, job presentation, meeting, etc.). I consider myself to be rather flexible in what I do on iTalki. 

During the lesson, I will be constantly listening to your English and offering corrections, suggestions, or new words and expressions. Many of these will also be typed out. If I notice consistent mistakes or major grammatical errors, additional focus can be placed on correcting those mistakes. I am also open to any questions you may have regarding English (grammar questions, questions about something your read or watched, questions about slang, etc.). 

Ultimately, the goal of these lessons is to improve a student's confidence and comfortability in speaking with a native speaker. Speaking with anyone in a foreign language can be very intimidating at first, but it is my hope that you will feel comfortable and able to speak freely without fear. This is not a judgement zone. 

** PLEASE NOTE that I do NOT teach children. I believe that teaching children requires particular experience. I recommend that you look for one of the many great professional teachers or community tutors on iTalki who have experience teaching children and especially beginners. 

If you are interested in purchasing a package of lessons but have not yet spoken to me, please contact me beforehand so we can discuss your goals and desires for the lesson.

NEW STUDENTS: If you are booking a lesson with me for the first time, please send a brief message along with your request. I ask for this so I know prospective students have read my profile description and watched my introduction video. For example:

- Hello, Aura. I'd like to practice my English conversation skills. I'm looking forward to speaking with you soon.
- Hello, Aura. I don't have many opportunities to practice English conversation, so I'd like to book a session with you to practice.
- Nice to meet you, Aura. I would like to improve my English speaking skills, and I would appreciate it if you could correct my mistakes and teach me how to speak more naturally.

As long as you have a basic understanding of English, you are welcome to practice English conversation with me. We can talk about everyday topics, or maybe you have an interesting life story to share.

I'm open to different topics, but I always enjoying talking about food, cooking, nutrition, health, holistic living, yoga, creativity, language learning, Japan, travel, world cultures, music, and technology, for example.

Some examples of other activities I've done with students:
- Scene description using pictures, photographs, or film clips
- The student describes a word and I try to guess the word, or vice versa
- I teach an idiom or other expression, and the student tries to guess the meaning
- Practicing tongue twisters

As a native speaker of American English, I can help you find the words and expressions to express yourself naturally.

- Hello, Aura. Could you help me proofread my one-page essay for my English class?
- Hello, Aura. Can we practice reading an article together and then discuss it afterwards? Can you correct my pronunciation when I read the article?
- Nice to meet you, Aura. I would like to practice giving my work presentation with you. If I book a session, could you give me some feedback?

Reading Practice:
We can practice reading online articles, or maybe you have your own material you'd like to practice reading with me.  I can correct your pronunciation, word stress, and tell you how to properly link certain words together. For example, the phrase, "What are you going to do today?" sounds more like: "Whaddar ya gonna do taday?" when spoken out loud. We can do shadowing practice. I can read some text and then you can repeat after me, trying to match my rhythm, intonation, pronunciation, and word stress. Or, you can read it by yourself without shadowing me.

Proofreading:
I can check pieces of writing such as e-mails or short essays for errors and clarity. I proofread documents during the lesson time, with the student.

Presentation Practice:
Maybe you need to give a PowerPoint presentation or speech at an event or assembly. You can practice it with me while I give necessary corrections and feedback.

Please Note: I don't offer structured English lessons. Conversation only

My goal is to offer a relaxed conversational setting for students who already have some degree of speaking proficiency, but want to be able to speak more confidently and naturally. I'll want you to speak freely, and I’ll try to make corrections in a way that doesn’t detract too much from the conversation. It's important that you relax and not be afraid to make mistakes, because making mistakes is the best way to improve. We can talk about virtually any topic that interests you, and I can offer you suggestions for making your spoken English more idiomatic and native-sounding.

pro_course_detail.title: German Grammar and Conversation for Self-Learners
pro_course_detail.description:
Please Note: I don't offer structured German lessons for beginners. 

My goal is to help self-study students or those already taking some type of formal instruction.

I especially welcome learners having difficulty with German grammar. When I first started teaching myself, I realized I didn't understand the German grammatical terms and concepts. Then it dawned on me that I didn't really understand them in my native language, English, either. So I had to stop and learn all that before I could go any further. If you, like me, picked up your native language without thinking much about its grammar, I can help you learn what you need to know to understand German grammar.

Of course, understanding German grammar and being able to use it are two different things. If your goal is to speak German spontaneously and correctly, certain concepts and information must be internalized. There are various methods for accomplishing this, and the right way is the one that works best for you. As a self-learner, I tried virtually every resource I could get my hands on, so I can give you lots of suggestions.

In any case, I'll give you the opportunity to speak German as much as possible, either as a means of putting grammatical concepts into practice, or just for the fun of it.
